doc: A file that is not UTF-8 (FBL section 2.6): line 3 holds the byte 0xE9 of Latin-1 for é, which no UTF-8 sequence starts that way. The body is unreadable (FBL section 7.5): it opens as an empty, read-only model with one std.unparseable finding, at line 3, and is never written, so a save writes nothing (FR-054).

steps.doc: A save of an unreadable body writes nothing (FBL section 6.6).
